systems.system: Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS) for Somalia's Justice Chain Institutions
systems.platform: to be developed by the winning bidder; none named
systems.owner: IDLO as procurer, for the beneficiary institutions
systems.tiers: Mogadishu only: Attorney General Office, Police (CID), Supreme Court, Benadir Regional Court, Benadir Appeal Court and Mogadishu Central Prison

note: No fact: IDLO's request for proposal of 19 April 2024 (deadline 3 June 2024, 15 months of services) for a justice-chain case management system whose only police beneficiary is the CID in Mogadishu, so it is classed exchange and no station is named. The capture is an excerpt: it ends within Annex A, before the terms of reference and the module list, so what the system does at the police end was not read.
